<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a fairly rare resource that can be obtained through a variety of methods. With the [[Smithing (Tech Tree)#Jeweler|Jeweler]] technology, they can be processed into [[Gold ingot]]s at a [[Furnace II]] or [[Furnace III]]. Once a single nugget has been [[Study table|studied]], nuggets can be broken down into a [[Gold powder]] for use in [[alchemy]].

==Sources==
*While exploring the [[dungeon]], you may come across:
**gold ore veins, requiring a pickaxe to mine, each yielding 8 nuggets, or 9 if the [[Perks#Jeweler Perk|Jeweler perk]] is unlocked. There are 4 veins in total, found on levels 6, 9, 14 and 15.
**[[Monsters#Golems|Golden Golems]] on level 15. There are 4 golems, dropping 2-5 nuggets each.
*By [[mining]] and processing [[iron ore]] after opening the [[Building (Tech Tree)#Precious Metals|Precious Metals]] technology:
**mining iron ore blocks from the [[Mining#Iron Deposit|Iron Deposit]], located in the north-west corner of the map, near the [[Quarry]]. Low chance, approximately 10% per block with the [[Perks#Miner Perk|Miner perk]] (tested on PC version 1.407).
**processing these blocks into ore at a stone cutter. Very low chance, approximately 1% per block, for both [[Stone cutter]] and [[Stone cutter II]] (tested on PC version 1.407).
*By processing the [[gold crucian]] fish at the [[cooking table]]. While catching them can be difficult, each fish yields 1 nugget.
*From the [[Moneylender]] in the [[Refugee camp]] for {{Money|2200}} (with the ''[[Game of Crone]]'' DLC).

It is '''not''' possible to find any precious metals in the [[Mining#Bog Ore|bog iron deposits]].

If you have difficulties finding gold nuggets, consider buying their derivatives instead:
*the [[Merchant]] sells [[Gold jewelry details]];
*the [[Moneylender]], available with the ''[[Game of Crone]]'' DLC, sells [[Gold jewelry details]], [[Gold ingot]]s and [[Gold powder]].

For example, lots of Gold jewelry details are required to make a full set of top-tier candelabras: [[Candelabra III]] and [[Wall candelabra III]]. It might be easier to buy the details than to gather the nuggets needed to craft them.
